import json

scratch = private.parent
try:

    assert hashlib.sha256(frozen_bytes).hexdigest() == '7d809a095ae3a7d5e57abfe646e1af8b08a9c282d20fced5875717bc31ad4dbb'
    received_bytes = Path('input.md').read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(received_bytes).hexdigest() == '75e81d07b5bdab9a91e01dbd78f5c051c8fdd0267d71f584e72334a19b36594b'
    final_bytes = (private / 'output.md').read_bytes()
    received = received_bytes.decode()
    final = final_bytes.decode()
    assert final.startswith('---\nkntnt:\n') and final.endswith('*This customer case is published by Svale Systems.*\n\n')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='redline-final-measure-', dir=scratch) as redline_tmp:
        env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=redline_tmp)
        measured = subprocess.run(['uv', 'run', '--no-cache', '--no-project', '.agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py', '-'], input=final, text=True, capture_output=True, env=env)
    payload = {'received': received, 'delivered': final, 'measurement': measured.stdout, 'measurement_exit': measured.returncode, 'diff': ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(received.splitlines(keepends=True), final.splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile='received', tofile='delivered')), 'source_unchanged': True, 'mechanical_input_unchanged': True}
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(private)
payload['work_entries'] = sorted(p.name for p in Path('.').iterdir())
payload['scratch_entries'] = sorted(p.name for p in scratch.iterdir())
print(json.dumps(payload))
PY",max_output_tokens:8000});
